transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this week's sustainment huddle started. We've got 5,000 gallons of potable water coming in for the week, and I need each activity representative to provide their formal update on water requirements. I know the standard weekly requests — 1,300 for the dining facility, 1,100 for sanitation, 900 for the motor pool, and 400 for the clinic — but if anything has changed for your area, now is the time to disclose it through your formal update entry so I can finalize the distribution plan. Anyone have any changes or additional requirements to flag?
